startNewPolygon.title: Start a new polygon
startNewPolygon.desc: Press [chip]Q[/chip] → click with mouse → a new polygon will start.

addPointToPolygon.title: Add point
addPointToPolygon.desc: Press [chip]A[/chip] → click with mouse → point is added to the last polygon.

deleteSelection.title: Delete selection
deleteSelection.desc: Press [chip]Delete[/chip] → selected points or polygons are deleted.

snapPoints.title: Snap feature
snapPoints.desc: Press [chip]S[/chip] → selected points are aligned to the nearest point.

alignPointToEdge.title: Align point to edge
alignPointToEdge.desc: Press [chip]D[/chip] → selected point aligns to neighboring point on the edge.

autoSnapOnDrag.title: Auto snap while dragging
autoSnapOnDrag.desc: When dragging, if a point is near another on X/Y axis, it auto-aligns ([chip]10px[/chip] tolerance).

addPointToEdge.title: Add point to edge
addPointToEdge.desc: Press [chip]W[/chip] → adds a point to the closest polygon edge.

moveSelection.title: Move selection
moveSelection.desc: Use [chip]arrow keys[/chip] → moves selected polygons by [chip]5px[/chip].

cloneWithArrows.title: Clone with arrow keys
cloneWithArrows.desc: Use [chip]Ctrl + arrow keys[/chip] → clones polygons in that direction (prevents overlap).

clearSnapGuides.title: Clear snap guides
clearSnapGuides.desc: Snap lines disappear when mouse is released.

resetCloneCounter.title: Reset clone counter
resetCloneCounter.desc: Press [chip]Escape[/chip] → resets clone count created with [chip]Ctrl + arrow[/chip].

selectPolygon.title: Select polygon
selectPolygon.desc: Click a polygon → selects it; click again to deselect. Selected polygons appear [chip]blue[/chip].

selectPoint.title: Select point
selectPoint.desc: Double click a point → selects it; double click again to deselect. Selected points appear [chip]blue[/chip].

dragPoint.title: Drag point
dragPoint.desc: Hold and drag a point with the mouse.

changeBackground.title: Change background
changeBackground.desc: Select an image using the ImageSelectionPanel below.

alignmentGuides.title: Alignment guide lines
alignmentGuides.desc: While snapping, blue lines are shown for alignment (like Figma).

visualEffect.title: Visual effect
visualEffect.desc: Snap lines are highlighted using [chip]drop-shadow[/chip] effect.

undoHistoryLimit.title: Undo history limit
undoHistoryLimit.desc: You can go back up to [chip]200[/chip] actions (undo/redo memory).

clonePolygonBelow.title: Clone polygon below (with gap)
clonePolygonBelow.desc: Press [chip]Space[/chip] → selected polygons are cloned below with [chip]10px[/chip] spacing.

copySelection.title: Copy polygon
copySelection.desc: Press [chip]Ctrl + C[/chip] to copy the selected polygons.

pasteSelection.title: Paste polygon
pasteSelection.desc: Press [chip]Ctrl + V[/chip] to paste the last copied polygons.

mergePoints.title: Merge points
mergePoints.desc: Press [chip]M[/chip] to merge multiple selected points into an average position.
